summary: Jefferies Financial Group Inc. filed a preliminary pricing supplement (424B5) for an offering of Senior Autocallable Contingent Coupon Barrier Notes due 2032 linked to the worst-performing of the KRE ETF and S&P 500 Index. The notes are part of its Series A Global Medium-Term Notes program. The aggregate principal amount will be set later; issue price is $1,000 per note. This is a routine debt securities offering, not a special situation. Payments are subject to the issuer's credit risk, and the notes are unsecured. No transactional event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring is involved.
